paragraphs: I am Tom, and I am twelve years old. Tomorrow is Thursday, and it is Project Day in our class. Teacher Nick gives us a timetable on a piece of paper. I read it to Ben on the way home. Ben is in the other group. My group has four children, and each child has a job. My group has a pirate project. We make a short play in English. We have a lot to do.

The day begins at eight o'clock. At a quarter past eight, each group makes a plan. At nine o'clock, my group writes the play. I write the first part. At half past ten, we have a break. At eleven o'clock, we make pirate hats from paper. We use red and black paper. We eat lunch at a quarter to one. Ben's group does a science project in the morning, too.

After lunch, the groups show their work. At one o'clock, Ben's group shows how a candle burns. Teacher Nick stands next to the table to keep us safe. No one touches the candle. Everyone watches very quietly. The small light is bright. At a quarter past two, my group plays the pirate play. I am the captain, and I wear a paper hat. Ben laughs at my funny hat.

At three o'clock, we clean the room. We put the old paper in the bin. Then we finish the day with a short talk. "Do you like the timetable?" asks Ben. "Yes, I do," I say. "I will be early at school on Thursday." "I want to be a good pirate!"
